steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Place potatoes in a large pot of salted boiling water, bring water back to a boil. Cook until potatoes are tender, approximately 15 to 20 minutes. Drain well. Let cool.

When potatoes are cooled, cut them into small chunks. Using an electric blender, whip potatoes with sour cream, cream cheese and garlic salt. Place mixture in a 9x13 inch casserole dish. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese.

raw_recipe.headline: Fancy Potatoes
raw_recipe.description: Potatoes are blended with sour cream and cream cheese and topped with Cheddar cheese, for a rich and creamy side dish you'll want to make again and again.
raw_recipe.name: Fancy Potatoes

When potatoes are cooled, cut them into small chunks. Using an electric blender, whip potatoes with sour cream, cream cheese and garlic salt. Place mixture in a 9x13 inch casserole dish. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese.

review.reviewBody: I boiled 5 huge potatoes, Whipped them up with the cream cheese and sour cream. Then I mixed in the garlic powder and a bunch of green onions,and the cheddar cheese. Then baked - I don't know how long - I wanted the top crisp so the last 5 minutes I turned the oven up to 375. They were SO DELICIOUS !!! If you try these don't forget to add the green onions (or Chives) because it made a BIG difference.(Also 1 Pkg of cream cheese is plenty) These are Super Yummy !!!

Next time, I'd add either real garlic or more than a pinch. It's also very thick before baking and I was toying with adding milk or butter. It loosens up some when cooking, but I'd still add something. As for taste, I'd add anything on hand like green onions, bacon, peppers. I'd also brown it under the broiler for a bit. It could definitely use salt and pepper.

So So good I read the reviews and the only things I changed were I used garlic powder instead of garlic salt and I mixed half the chedder cheese into the potatos then put the rest on top. I also added 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese mixed in and about 1/3 cup green onions. And sprinkled the top with black pepper before baking. So great will make again and again. Oh yeah one cream cheese is plenty.

I made this for a party, and everyone loved them! I used the potatoes as a base for making a kind of vegetarian Shepard's pie. I sauteed a variety of vegetables, and mixed them in with the potatoes. I also put one cup of the shredded cheddar in the potatoes and another cup on top. This turned out excellent; EVERYONE was asking me for the recipe! Next time, though, I will make it with a crust and it should be really incredible.

What's not to like in this recipe? Very yummy......... I made a variation tonight to make this a main dish. I cut the recipe in half and added three chopped green onions that I 'sauteed' with just about a 1/2 teaspoon of butter in the microwave. I chopped up 1/3 lb. of kielbasa and nuked that so I could drain the excess fat. Instead of mashing the potatoes I cubed them after boiling them. Cubing before boiling makes them absorb too much water. I've learned from the cooking shows to put the potatoes in the pan whole or cut in half, cover with water, and then put them on the heat. Bring to a boil and boil until done........ . . I threw it all together and baked for twenty minutes. Served this with green beans. Thanks for helping me make an easy, tasty dinner tonight.

I thought these were good, but definitely not something I would make all of the time. They are so rich and way too fattening for my blood!! I did add bacon bits, used real minced garlic as opposed to the garlic salt and then threw in some salt and pepper to taste. I also used HALF of the cream cheese called for, and fat free cream cheese AND sour cream - just to take away some of the guilt! I chose to mash these instead of whip and if making again, I would stir the cheese into the potato mixture instead of sprinkling it on top, and just bake it for less time. I found the cheese "crust" distracting as it pulled away from the spuds with every bite.
Was very good after adding 2 bunch of green onions and omitting 1 8oz brick of cream cheese. Will make again. May add some cooked bacon.

Very good potatoe side dish recipe! 
I followed the directions with these minor additions...

I used red skins, keeping skin on and boiled them in garlic infused water. (add minced garlic to water)
I too followed others advise and cut cream cheese in half and I used shredded cheese mixed with panko bread crumbs for topping to give some crunch.

Thank You for this recipe!

I had about 9 potatoes left in my bag, so just went ahead & used them all in the recipe. I also sauteed one small onion in butter & added that, along with substituting garlic powder (1/2 tsp) & also added about 1/2 tsp salt & 1/4 tsp black pepper. I did only use one pkg of cream cheese, & mixed my shredded cheese into the mixture, instead of putting on top. Very good.

This is the best mashed potato recipe I've ever had. It is really creamy. I followed the advice of some of the reviewers and used one package of cream cheese instead of 2. I also mixed in the cheddar and sprinkled just a bit on top. I will definitely make this again...many many times.

Good recipe. 1 package of cream cheese is plenty. 1 cup of sour cream is too much. I used half a cup the second time around and it turned out a lot better. I mixed in the cheddar cheese and 1/4 cup of chives.

The recipe should be called fancy cheese, not potatoes. I followed the recipe as posted (as always) - I can’t taste any potatoes. I recommend editing the recipe lowering cream cheese and sour cream concentration.

Definitely only 8 oz cream cheese. Also, “5 large” potatoes is way too vague. What is a large potato? I found a similar recipe. 4 lbs of potatoes and only 8ox cream cheese with the cup of sour cream. I also mixed cheese along with sautéed onions and fresh garlic. Finally sprinkled cheese on on top.
Amazing! so delicious! my hubby absolutely loves this dish. One package of cream cheese is plenty!!
Pretty solid dish, tasty and easy to make!
I did not make changes, it was wonderful, and I will make it again.

Family and I loved this!!! Kids asked for seconds and it was even a big hit with my toddler. Only put in 3/4 of a 250gr tub of cream cheese and it was plenty. Can’t wait to make again. Strongly recommend

FOLLOWED THE DIRECTIOS EXACTLY EASY TO MAKE. ADDED A LITTE EXTRA CHEESESINCE MY FAMILY ARE CHEESE LOVERS. A HUGE SUCCESS SERVED WITH AM. MINIMAL MESS. JUST MY STYLE. OH, FORGOT TO MENTION I SRAYED MY PAN WITH PAM FOR EASY CLEANUP, FIRST.
Loved this!! Big hit!!

I only had 1 block of cream cheese so hoped it would taste just as good and it was!! A hit by two picky teen boys. Will definitely make this again!! Oh I did add 1 tablespoon of milk to help it blend in blender.
